name: kesher-shira-saharoni
description: Structured tools for relationship conversations, parenting routines, mediation preparation, and choosing an appropriate support path.

interface.longDescription: Kesher provides structured, practical frameworks for common relationship, parenting, and mediation questions. It can help users choose between couples counseling, parenting guidance, mediation, or a self-guided conversation plan; prepare a calmer conversation around a recurring conflict; build a practical parenting routine; and organize topics before mediation. The skills are based on Shira Saharoni's published educational approach and are designed to avoid diagnosis, medical advice, legal advice, or emergency counseling. This skills-only plugin does not run an external server or send conversation content to Shira Saharoni. It may point to relevant public resources or professional services only when that matches the user's request.
capabilities: Match a relationship or parenting situation to an appropriate support path
Build structured plans for difficult couple and family conversations
Create practical parenting routines for recurring home friction
Prepare a neutral agenda for mediation without giving legal advice
defaultPrompt: Help me decide whether we need couples counseling, parenting guidance, mediation, or a conversation plan.
Help me plan a calmer conversation about a conflict that keeps repeating in our relationship.
Build a practical morning routine for a child who struggles with attention, transitions, and organization.

publication.release_notes: Initial skills-only release for relationship communication, parenting routines, mediation preparation, and support-path guidance.
